Weather Update Today: agle 24 ghanto ke lie bihar, yupi samet kaee rajyon men mausam ka kahar | N18V | IMD
Agar aap uttar pradesh, bihar, dilli, ya desh ke kisi bhi any rajy men rah rahe hain, to agle 24 se 48 ghante aapke lie behad bhari hone vale hain. chakravat 'murasu' bhale hi kamjor par raha ho, lekin iska bacha huaa hissa yani remnents ab pure desh men tabahi machane ke lie taiyar hai! mausam vibhag yani IMD ne aaj 5 navanbar 2026 ko desh ke 15 rajyon ke lie bhari barish aur 70 kilomitar prati ghante ki raphtar se chalne vali aandhi ka maha-alart jari kar diya hai.
